description: Update a draft invoice. Give only the fields to change; lineItems replaces the whole list; billingEntityId changes the sender and may renumber the draft. Finalized invoices cannot be changed.

billingEntityId.description: Sender, from list_billing_entities. Left out, the company settings are the sender, not the default entity

lineItems.description: Invoice lines; amounts are net in the invoice currency, e.g. 95.5

serviceEndDate.description: End of the service period, YYYY-MM-DD

serviceStartDate.description: Start of the service period, YYYY-MM-DD

name: update_invoice
title: Update draft invoice
